decisions.rationale: Fix verified in current bytes: step 2 now has a required 'url' goal (TOPIC.goals[2] = url, ok, fail) with a URL input whose run() checks the learner-typed URL against PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE. Ran run() in node: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/shop sets the goal; postgresql://... (missing jdbc:), jdbc:postgres:..., missing //, missing port, port 5433, database shopp, swapped host/database and empty input are each refused with a distinct targeted message. Connection buttons are blocked until the URL is built (act('conn') with no url goal returns 'no URL yet'), and the static alt explains each URL part. o1 is therefore no longer credited without the URL-building behaviour.

Fix verified in current bytes: run() now has a separate case-sensitive /^jdbc:/ branch after the case-insensitive one. Ran the extracted URL-builder run() in node: JDBC:postgresql://localhost:5432/shop and Jdbc:postgresql://... now get 'Write the prefix jdbc: in lower case. pgJDBC matches the whole jdbc:postgresql: prefix exactly', which names the wrong part (the prefix) instead of the subprotocol; jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/shop still sets the url goal; postgresql://... (no jdbc:), jdbc:postgres:, jdbc:PostgreSQL:, missing //, missing port, port 5433 and empty input still each receive their distinct targeted message. The message matches pgJDBC's case-sensitive startsWith("jdbc:postgresql:") URL acceptance.
